title: Verbo to be: am, is, are
lines: Usa am con I, is con he/she/it y are con you/we/they: I am, she is, they are.
Para preguntar, cambia el orden: Are you ready? Where is the bank?
Para negar, agrega not: He is not (isn't) here. Para contraer: I'm, it's, we're.

title: Presente simple
lines: Sirve para hábitos y hechos: I work every day. I live in Lima.
Con he, she e it, el verbo lleva -s: she works, he lives, it opens.
Con I, you, we y they el verbo no cambia: we eat, they study.

title: Do y does en preguntas y negativas
lines: Para preguntar en presente usa do o does y el verbo base: Do you have a fever?
Does va con he, she e it, y el verbo pierde la -s: Does she like tea?
Para negar usa don't o doesn't: I don't eat meat. He doesn't like it.
examples: My brother doesn't wash the dishes.

title: Can, could y should
lines: Can, could y should van seguidos del verbo base, sin to ni -s: She can help.
Could suena más amable para pedir favores: Could you speak slower, please?
Should da un consejo: You should drink water. Para negar: can't, shouldn't.

title: I'd like y would you like
lines: I'd like significa quisiera. Es la forma cortés de pedir algo: I'd like a coffee.
Para ofrecer, pregunta: Would you like some water?
Si sigue un verbo, usa to: We would like to order now.
examples: I'd like a room for two nights.
Would you like something to drink?

title: There is y there are
lines: Significan hay. Usa there is con una cosa y there are con varias.
Para preguntar, cambia el orden: Is there a pharmacy near here?
Para negar: There isn't a bank here. There aren't any seats.
examples: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

title: Presente continuo
lines: Se forma con am, is o are más el verbo con -ing: I am working.
Sirve para lo que pasa ahora o para algo temporal: She is cooking dinner.
Para preguntar, invierte el orden: What are you reading?
examples: We are staying here until Sunday.

title: Pasado simple
lines: Los verbos regulares terminan en -ed: worked, played, cleaned.
Muchos son irregulares y hay que aprenderlos: go, went; buy, bought; eat, ate.
Para preguntar o negar usa did y el verbo base: Did you go? I did not go.
examples: I bought these shoes last week.

title: Futuro: going to y will
lines: Be going to más verbo expresa un plan: I'm going to visit my cousin.
Will más verbo expresa una decisión del momento: I'll take it.
Es igual para todas las personas: I'll call, she'll call, they'll call.

title: Preposiciones: at, on, in
lines: Usa at para horas y puntos exactos: at eight, at the corner.
Usa on para días y superficies: on Monday, on the second floor.
Usa in para meses y lugares grandes: in May, in Lima. Para ubicar: next to, near, across from.
examples: The station is next to the park.

title: Imperativo: dar instrucciones
lines: Para dar una instrucción usa el verbo base, sin sujeto: Turn left. Take this medicine.
Para decir que no, usa don't: Don't worry. Don't turn right.
Let's más verbo es una invitación a hacer algo juntos: Let's go to the beach.
